Use WHENEVER a build derives identifiers from user/AI/import data: "slug from a title", "column name from a spreadsheet header", "make these keys unique", "map fields to a table", "these two names collide", "reserved/system column clash", "why did two records overwrite each other", or any name→key mapping feeding storage. Guardrail: identifiers must be derived from name + order ONLY (never a random id or timestamp) or the mapping stops being idempotent and re-runs churn the schema.
